text.en: This Act may be cited as the Unlawful Carnal Know-Short title

Any person who has or attempts to have carnal know-Prohibition of a girl under the age of 16 years except by way of of carnal of marriage shall be guilty of an offence: Penalty, imprison-girl under 16 nlent for a term which shall not be less tli"an 2 years and not years more than 7 years and to whipping not exceeding 24 strokes of the rattan in the case of an adult or 12 strokes of the rattan in the case of a youthful offender.
It shall be a sufficient defence to any charge under Defence this Act that the person charged had reasonable cause to believe that the girl was of or above the age of 16 years.

The Court of a Magistrate shall have jurisdiction over Jurisdiction offences under this Act and, notwithstanding anything to the contrary which may be contained in the Criminal Procedure Code, shall have power to impose the full penalty.
